lines.zh: 我八条腿一起划，泥在翻。
lines.en: My eight legs paddle together and mud churns.
I shift along the shallows.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，泥翻得更松。
lines.en: Where I pass, the mud turns looser.

lines.zh: 我拖着长长的尾巴往前。
lines.en: I drag my long tail behind me.

lines.zh: 我爬到岸上，壳还是湿的。
lines.en: I climb ashore with my shell still wet.
I walk slowly toward the field.

lines.zh: 我的壳在泥里划出一道沟。
lines.en: My shell cuts a furrow in the mud.
I slip at every step, heavy and clumsy.
I turn my head your way.
I crawl through a clump of grass and it falls flat.
I plough slowly across the field.

lines.zh: 我从泥坑爬出来，很费劲。
lines.en: I climb out of the mud pit with effort.

lines.zh: 我一路耙着泥，边走边吃。
lines.en: I rake the mud as I walk, eating as I go.

lines.zh: 我把前面的土推到两边。
lines.en: I push the soil to either side.
I stop and shift on again.
I walk along the waterline.

lines.zh: 我的腿一前一后，很整齐。
lines.en: My legs move front then back, in order.

lines.zh: 我朝软一点的地爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl toward softer ground.
I lie on the mud without moving.
My legs stir slowly in the mud.
I am searching the mud for scraps.
My tail rests in the water.
Head up slow, turning the mud over.
A few drops sit on my shell.
I lie in the sun.

lines.zh: 我在听水渗进泥里的声。
lines.en: I listen to water seeping into mud.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地晃了一下尾巴。
lines.en: I sway my tail slowly.
I spit out the mud by my mouth.

lines.zh: 泥在我身下积成一小片肥土。
lines.en: Mud gathers under me into a patch of rich soil.

lines.zh: 我一点一点地把腿伸直。
lines.en: I straighten my legs one by one.
I bring my head near the ground.
I wait for the mud to soften more.

lines.zh: 我试着挪了半寸，又停了。
lines.en: I try half an inch, then stop.
I slowly scrape the mud aside.
Would you like to ride on my back?
I go slowly here, but steadily.
I know the mud pole in your hand.
My shell is large and flat.
Step on me; I will not mind.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看你这个尺寸。
lines.en: I raise my head to your size.
I am muddy; do not mind.
I have always been gentle.
When you speak, I do not understand.
I shift toward you slowly.

lines.zh: 你愿意帮我犁那片地吗？
lines.en: Will you help me plough that field?
I turn my head away and go back to raking.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下腿，退了半寸。
lines.en: I pull in a leg and retreat half an inch.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了，我用泥把它糊上。
lines.en: My shell cracked; I smear mud over it.
The mud I rake is richer than anyone's.
I shift slowly aside.

lines.zh: 背甲凹了一块，泥水灌进来。
lines.en: A dent in my back plate; mud seeps in.

lines.zh: 泥里的气泡替我哼了一声。
lines.en: A bubble in the mud grunts for me.
I curl my tail a little.
I stop and recover a moment.
Mud still clings to the wound.
I raise a front leg to guard.

lines.zh: 那把泥竿，是要指挥我吗？
lines.en: Is that mud pole for guiding me?
The direction you point, I understand.
I smell that soft mud.

lines.zh: 你把泥放在我前面就行。
lines.en: Just put the mud in front of me.
I turn toward your pole.
That field is not finished.
You dig, and I crawl over.
Bits of leaf in the mud; best of all.

lines.zh: 你把竿子放低，我才看得清。
lines.en: Lower the pole so I can see it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢跟着你指的方向。
lines.en: I follow where you point.
The mud in your hand; give it to me.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，你也听见了。
lines.en: I called out, and you heard.

lines.zh: 我朝你身后的田爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl toward the field behind you.
Turn the soil and I will follow.
I ploughed that field.
I crouch down and wait for you to climb on.
You bump me and get mud on you.
I bump into you, very heavy.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的节肢，我整条腿缩起。
lines.en: You step on my joint; I pull the whole leg in.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，泥水溅了一身。
lines.en: We collide and mud splashes on us both.

lines.zh: 我挡不住，被你推得横了一点。
lines.en: I cannot hold and turn slightly sideways.
The edge of my shell scrapes you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地从你身上挪开。
lines.en: I shift slowly off you.

lines.zh: 我的尾剑扫过，你踉跄了一下。
lines.en: My tail blade sweeps past; you stumble.

lines.zh: 相撞后，我伏在泥里不动。
lines.en: After the bump, I lie still in the mud.

lines.zh: 我横着挪开，八条腿陷进泥。
lines.en: I shuffle aside; eight legs sink in the mud.
I only want soft mud.
At this size, it would not do.

lines.zh: 我用螯碰了碰另一副背甲。
lines.en: I tap another back plate with my claw.
There is work in the mud.
I do not understand the question.
I lie there and do not respond.
My shell is worn.
I sway my tail gently.
I do very little of that.
I crawl off toward the field.

lines.zh: 我用须把泥里的东西挑出来。
lines.en: I sift the thing out of the mud with my feelers.
I sweep it to my mouth.
This clod is good; it can be eaten.
I grip it with my legs and move it slowly.
I cannot drag the bigger ones.

lines.zh: 耙泥的螯，把它推到一边。
lines.en: These mud-raking claws push it aside.
I pick it up and sniff the mud on it.
I gather what falls too.
I slowly bury it.
I flick it aside with a front leg.
I follow that pole of yours.
I turn toward your side.
Are you pointing at that patch?
Let me find the heading first.
I crawl slowly your way.
The smell of mud is strong there.
I have chosen this field.
I raise my head to look at you.

lines.zh: 泥里翻出的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: The smell turned up from the mud: I remember it.
I head for where the pole points.

lines.zh: 我一直朝着竿子的方向。
lines.en: I keep to the pole's direction.
You take a step, I crawl a little.
I follow slowly behind you.
You point there, and I turn.
My trail in the mud is straight.
I am not fast, but I do not drift.
You stop at the field edge; so do I.
My legs paddle, stroke by stroke.

lines.zh: 我跟着你绕开那块石头。
lines.en: I follow you around that stone.
You raise your hand and I see it.
One sweep of my tail knocks you down.
My shell hits your leg.
My great claw clamps you into the mud.
I push you with a front leg.
My tail trips you.
I bear down and you back away.
That felt like being hit by a cart.
I shift away to let you get up.
Not fast, but very heavy.
That one came with mud.

lines.zh: 泥面鼓起一块，我出来了。
lines.en: The mud bulges and I come out.

lines.zh: 我从浅水里慢慢爬上岸。
lines.en: I crawl slowly out of the shallows.
You see the shell above the water first.
I poke my head out of the mud.
I land and mud sprays.
I stop at the field edge, breathing hard.

lines.zh: 我把周围的泥翻了一遍。
lines.en: I have turned over the mud around me.

lines.zh: 我把泥土耙松，让它更肥。
lines.en: I rake the soil loose and richer.
The water here begins to cloud.
I drift slowly toward your side.

lines.zh: 我先动一条腿，然后全部。
lines.en: One leg moves first, then all of them.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从深泥里拱出来。
lines.en: I slowly heave up out of the deep mud.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的壳发烫，我往水里爬。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell and I crawl toward water.

lines.zh: 我从岸上翻下去，摔进泥里。
lines.en: I tumble off the bank into the mud.

lines.zh: 水没过头，我八条腿一起乱划。
lines.en: Water closes over me and all eight legs thrash.
The blast flips me shell-down.
An arrow strikes my shell and does not go in.
A spell passes and my legs stiffen.

lines.zh: 好久没吃到泥里的东西了。
lines.en: Long without anything from the mud.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅水，我缩回泥里。
lines.en: Lightning struck the shallows; I sink back into mud.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，我的腿抓不住泥。
lines.en: The void pulls and my legs find no grip.
